name: Codex Vocifera
description: A sentient codex on creaky metal legs that knows much of the Biblioplex but is restricted by a redaction spell.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The Codex Vocifera tells Zimone that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti figured out the Vorzani Conjecture.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Jilesa suggests asking the Codex Vocifera, and the three go to find it.
timeline.quote: Don't just sit there, you two. We've got a codex to catch.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: They corner the Codex in the Void, which says the book's page is redacted and it cannot tell them its location.
timeline.quote: The page containing that information is redacted.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jilesa performs a lumimancy ritual with Esmun and Zarek's power to undo the redaction, and the Codex reveals the tome is in the Vaults of Turrau.
timeline.quote: The tome was taken from the Mystical Archive to the Vaults of Turrau

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Zarek learns the vault passcode and sets off alone, but Jilesa insists on joining and he relents.
timeline.quote: Your skills would be very useful. Are you sure you're up to the challenge?

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2026.

pages_say.description: A talking tome on four metal legs that tells Zimone what happened to her grandmother.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
